quarantine.text: Keep our patches in a private repository; customers only reach the service over HTTPS.
quarantine.reason: A modified AGPLv3 server reachable by remote users must offer its Corresponding Source (Section 13); private patches plus HTTPS-only access does not avoid that.
quarantine.replacement: Invariant: any modified AGPL component reachable by remote users ships with a working Corresponding Source offer, or is unmodified, or is replaced; a CI licence gate enforces it.
